title: auth_discoverer: discover register/login from target_intel observations or HTML link-scan, not just a hardcoded REGISTER_PATHS list
goal: auth_discoverer.fetch_auth_pages probes a hardcoded list of 15 register-paths + 13 login-paths. When a target's real auth endpoints are NOT in that list (Gruyere's `signup.gtl` + `saveprofile?action=new`; most production apps with `/account/new` variants, `/users` POST endpoints, SPA-routed `#/signup`, framework-specific paths like Rails `/users/sign_up`, ASP.NET `Account/Register`), fingerprint_application returns register_form=None. acquire_session() then returns None, and the 5 #328-migrated probes that consume it no-op with 0 findings. Live Gruyere confirms this 2026-05-18: register_form=None despite a working Gruyere instance with both register + login surfaces.
scope: Extend `api/app/services/auth_discoverer.fetch_auth_pages` to derive its probe-path set from TWO sources additive to the existing catalog: (1) URLs in the target's homepage HTML that text-match REGISTER_LINK_KEYWORDS / LOGIN_LINK_KEYWORDS (the existing link-scan in lines 292-340 already does this but is bounded by `probe_limit + 5` AND only fires when the index path is the FIRST candidate); (2) Stack-specific extensions injected from `target_intel` observations — if `stack_hints` contains `python_gruyere`, append `signup.gtl` + `saveprofile`; for `aspnet_webforms` append `Account/Register.aspx`; for `rails`, `/users/sign_up`; for `django`, `accounts/signup`. Plus: when fingerprint_application returns register_form=None BUT a form exists on a page classified as `kind=register` (even if score < threshold), elevate it to register_form rather than discard.
generation_reason: Live Gruyere run 9f951a0f: 16 pages fetched (Gruyere serves HTTP 200 on every path = soft-404), 0 with a register form, fingerprint says register_form=None. Gruyere's real register endpoint `/signup.gtl` is NOT in REGISTER_PATHS — `.gtl` paths were specifically stripped 'for generality' in #328. We threw away the working heuristic and the generic catalog covers 0% of Gruyere's auth surface. The #325 design — 'probe a fixed list of common paths' — is fundamentally insufficient for any app with non-standard endpoints. Per `feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes` we can't seed `.gtl` BACK into the list as a Gruyere-specific marker, but we can make the discovery target_intel-driven instead of catalog-driven.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Additive paths only — do NOT remove anything from the existing REGISTER_PATHS / LOGIN_PATHS catalogs (they still work for the apps they cover). Do NOT add app-specific RECIPES; only path-DISCOVERY hints. The recipe construction stays Claude-driven via build_recipe.
constraints.no_prescriptive_recipes: Per `feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes`: a `signup.gtl` path-string is a discovery hint, not an exploit recipe. The probes still need build_recipe / acquire_session to learn the form fields + flow. We're only saying 'try this path too', not 'send is_admin=True to this path'.
constraints.honest_link_scan: Tighten the existing index-page link-scan: when the index returns 200 + a body, scan ALL anchor hrefs (not just the first probe_limit+5), and ALWAYS include matched register/login candidates even if they put us over probe_limit. Probe limit was meant to bound NETWORK cost, not discovery breadth.

success_criteria: Live test against Gruyere (https://google-gruyere.appspot.com/<instance>/): fingerprint_application returns register_form != None AND login_form != None.
acquire_session() succeeds (returns a non-None session dict) against Gruyere.

After acquire_session succeeds, at least one of the 5 #328 migrated probes emits >= 1 finding on Gruyere (target: stored_xss_probe finds snippet XSS; OR param_pollution_probe finds is_admin=True mass assignment; OR cookie_tamper_probe finds pipe-delimiter forgery).
No regression: existing 17 fingerprint tests + 16 acquire_session tests still pass on Gruyere mock + ASP.NET mock + PHP mock.
target_intel observations with stack_hints drive path-set expansion (verifiable in unit test with a mocked target_intel observation feeding python_gruyere hint).
Link-scan picks up index-page `<a href="signup.gtl">` hrefs that the keyword regex matches, regardless of probe_limit.
must_not_touch: build_recipe (#326 contract — still synthesizes recipes from fingerprint)
workers/runners/target_intel/runner.py (we only READ its observations; no signature change)

acceptance_criteria: fingerprint_application returns register_form != None on Gruyere live.
At least one #328 probe emits >= 1 finding on Gruyere live.

SPA-style fragment-routed auth flows (Vue/React `#/signup`) — deferred to a Playwright-driven discoverer task.
